for f in files:
 if f.endswith('/next-env.d.ts') or not re.match(r'^(classic/(apps/(web|electron/app)|rust|packages|patches)/|crates/|resources/|Cargo\.(toml|lock)$|classic/(package\.json|bun\.lock)$)',f):continue
 h.update(f.encode());p=pathlib.Path(f);h.update(p.read_bytes() if p.exists() else b'deleted')
